answer: Every identity pays in thought each round. Because the tide is unpredictable in advance, answers cannot be bought wholesale and replayed. Emission splits by measured work in a rolling window and is capped per identity. Splitting one worker into fifty wallets leaves the cluster's combined share flat, so extra pigment buys dilution rather than income while the operator pays fifty times the generation cost. An attacker's arithmetic: N identities cost N independent generations per epoch forever, plus N chances of a failed grade, and the ledge is shared, not multiplied. Seal 1xjdo.
